English:
You've already surpassed your
father at swordsmanship, haven't you?
I'm not sure I'm there yet.

Once you do, we'll have a bona fide case
of “the student becoming the master.”

Just an old saying when the pupil or
son surpasses his master or father.

So I guess it's kinda like a half-elf
being stronger than a full-blooded one?
Hmmmm, well... In SOME ways, I suppose.
